item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: WAF Insights for Azure Front Door
item.description:
WAF Insights is now generally available for Azure Front Door Web Application Firewall (WAF). It adds built-in dashboards in the WAF policy that combine logs and metrics for investigating blocked requests.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Azure Boost observability for NVMe disks
item.description:
Azure Boost observability for NVMe disks is an open-source CLI tool for compatible Azure VMs. It reports remote disk I/O and latency metrics and maps each in-VM disk to the corresponding disk.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: New integration, hybrid deployment, and observability capabilities in Azure Logic Apps
item.description:
Azure Logic Apps added preview capabilities for enterprise integration, hybrid deployment, and observability. The update is aimed at running workflows across cloud and on-premises environments and modernizing legacy integrations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Policy support for Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure Policy support for Azure HorizonDB is now available in preview. A new built-in policy can automatically deploy diagnostic settings to help apply governance and observability standards across HorizonDB deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: OpenTelemetry in the GitHub Copilot app
item.description:
The GitHub Copilot app now supports OpenTelemetry configuration via enterprise-managed settings. This lets organizations observe Copilot agent performance and interactions with models and tools.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: k8s: Kubernetes v1.37: Native Histograms Graduates to Beta
item.description:
Kubernetes v1.37 enables native histogram support for metrics by default and moves the feature to Beta. Components now dual-expose classic buckets and native spans, and users must adjust Prometheus scraping and queries depending on Prometheus version.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog
